d: A tough-as-nails cop teams up with an undercover agent to shut down a sinister mobster and his crew.

An assassin hijacks a passenger train and threatens to detonate enough poison to wipe out an entire city. While the cops attempt to thwart his ransom, they call in former DEA agent Paul Blake - the one man who may be able to stop the deadly plot.
An undercover cop infiltrates a gang of thieves who plan to rob a jewelry store.

During a routine nighttime training mission in the Scottish Highlands, a small squad of British soldiers expected to rendezvous with a special ops unit instead find a bloody massacre with a sole survivor.
